# Policy-KB bijection audit — host_protection_and_claims_desk / task 0

Scope: the extended policies this task instantiates — `hostplan_ext_damage_report_evidence`,
`hostplan_ext_claim_opening`, `hostplan_ext_loss_appraisal`, `hostplan_ext_host_share` — together with every
base policy governing their subjects (`hostplan_evt_claim_intake`, `hostplan_evt_appraisal`,
`hostplan_evt_deductible`, `hostplan_evt_earnings_share`, `hostplan_enrollment_eligibility`,
`hostplan_lifecycle_standing`, `hostplan_plan_change`, `hostplan_agg_multi_holding`,
`hostplan_agg_portfolio_standing`), the `variants` parameter schedule, the three `measures`, and the eight
task-tool contracts as the hubs state them. The whole domain is scanned, not the branch this seed hits.

Entry conditions cited: the policy-side verdict for this difficulty is PASS at round 3;
`check_docs.py env/env_0015_car_sharing_marketplace hostplan` reports DOCS OK (82 docs, roles
hub 8 / policy 11 / factor 43 / facet 12 / baseline 8, 286 quantitative keys, 8 task tools, 6 prerequisite
edges, all mechanical gates PASS with the semantic bijection left to manual judgement);
`check_traceability.py .../tasks/host_protection_and_claims_desk` reports TRACEABILITY OK (0 missing on both
tasks). Both command outputs came with the brief; the auditor ran neither. The runtime-visible view and a
tool-shaped DB access path were supplied, so the DB side of the blind audit was genuinely blind.

## source_to_kb

### Baselines — every `baseline.rule` carried complete in its computation document

| Policy | Computation document | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| `hostplan_ext_damage_report_evidence` | `evidence_the_report_must_carry_347a527c.json` | complete |
| `hostplan_ext_claim_opening` | `provisional_figure_a_claim_opens_at_94ccefe8.json` | complete |
| `hostplan_ext_loss_appraisal` | `what_the_plan_accepts_on_an_appraised_loss_25bb78a3.json` | complete |
| `hostplan_ext_host_share` | `measuring_the_hosts_share_3cf8c1ff.json` | complete |

Sentence by sentence, every input, default, rounding, window, base, order and assembly step of each
`baseline.rule` is present, and the policy's own default constants are rendered as figures:

- evidence: "The count starts from the evidence minimum the plan publishes, taken as published, and nothing
  further is asked of the report" (doc opens with the same sentence, subject expanded to "The count of
  photographs and documents a damage report carries under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan"); "The count is
  a whole number of documents and is never below one" (verbatim); the per-plan evidence minimum
  (`baseline.params: evidence_minimum_photo_count`) is rendered as a six-row table, 8/8/10/12/12/14.
- claim opening: the provisional-figure sentence and the body-and-paint basis verbatim; the per-plan
  ceilings rendered; "rounded to two decimal places once, at the end" carried as "once, at the end and
  never at an intermediate step" — an entailment of "once, at the end", adding no normative content.
- appraisal: the unmanaged-repair rate rendered as "80 percent"; the single cap; the loss-of-use rule; the
  valuation fee rendered as "240"; **"The order is fixed: …" carried verbatim**, the only one of the eight
  baselines that carries an order sentence in the source.
- host share: the deductible basis, the ceiling at the money accepted, "rounded … once, after every rate has
  been applied, and the ceiling on it is applied to that rounded figure", and the per-plan deductible table.

### Factors — every declared factor's whole ladder, every tier

All 4 + 6 + 6 + 4 = 20 factors of this task's policies have their own document, and all of their tiers are
carried, every condition in full (both limbs of every compound condition, its window and its threshold) and
every value or method exactly as the source pins it. A mechanical sweep of all 130 tiers across the product
found 18 rendered as equivalent restatements rather than word-for-word; each was checked by hand and each
carries the same condition and the same result, differing only by resolving an anaphor ("that mark", "it")
or by rendering the constant the source names abstractly (e.g. "the marketplace's small-loss proportion" →
"the marketplace's small-loss proportion, 40 percent"). None of this task's tiers is dropped, merged,
rounded or softened, and no threshold is named under a business term without its figure.

Cross-difficulty findability, checked per factor: the care-plan factors name "the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan"
and the kinds of record they read (completed workshop visits, partner-network visits, included services
remaining); the listing factors name "the Keyturn Vehicle Listing" (odometer, model year, market valuation,
title status, value class, defect records, passed inspections, whether the listing is live); the payout
factor names "the Keyturn Host Payout Account" (reserves, hold); the roadside factors name "the Keyturn
Roadside Assistance record" (callouts, towing, what the callout was billed at). Each is reachable from the
words the records themselves use.

### Prerequisites — listed separately

| Blocked policy | Depends on | Form | Document carrying the sentence verbatim | Elsewhere? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hostplan_ext_claim_opening` | `hostplan_ext_damage_report_evidence` | state | `opening_a_claim_on_an_enrolment_2917b3ff.json` (hub) | in no other document |
| `hostplan_ext_loss_appraisal` | `hostplan_ext_claim_opening` | state | `appraisal_of_a_loss_on_an_enrolment_b1efdac5.json` (hub) | in no other document |
| `hostplan_ext_host_share` | `hostplan_ext_loss_appraisal` | state | `raising_the_hosts_share_of_a_loss_229023cf.json` (hub) | in no other document |

Resolution basis, at the source's strength, for each edge:

- *"A claim is opened on a loss only after a damage report for that trip stands on the register carrying the
  number of photographs and documents the plan asks of it."* The state is a report standing on the damage
  report register. `damage_report_register_entry_b66817de.json` describes the write that brings it about in
  exactly those words — "puts a fresh report on the damage report register for a named trip … with the
  stated number of photographs and supporting items attached" — and `find_hostplan_claim_intake` shows no
  row for booking `53ba5095-…`. Strength and connective ("only after") intact.
- *"The amount the plan accepts on a loss is not settled before a claim for that loss stands opened on the
  enrolment at a stated amount."* `opening_a_claim_on_an_enrolment` describes the write — "writes a new
  claim record against the enrolment carrying … the amount the claim is opened at". Connective ("not …
  before") intact.
- *"The host's share of a loss is fixed only after an appraisal of that loss stands on the enrolment with
  the money it accepts booked as owed to the host."* `appraisal_of_a_loss_on_an_enrolment` describes the
  write — "writes an appraisal record against the claim … and raises the enrolment's balance owed to the
  host by the accepted figure". Connective ("only after") intact.

No depended-on policy's document carries the blocked side's sentence. `condition`, `resolved_by` and
`effect` appear in no document, checked by a full-text scan of all 82 documents against each field.

### Base policies, untriggered branches and the retired surface

Every clause of `hostplan_evt_claim_intake`, `hostplan_evt_appraisal`, `hostplan_evt_deductible`,
`hostplan_evt_earnings_share`, `hostplan_enrollment_eligibility`, `hostplan_lifecycle_standing`,
`hostplan_plan_change`, `hostplan_agg_multi_holding` and `hostplan_agg_portfolio_standing` has a home, and
the branches this seed never triggers are carried with it: the total-loss settlement basis, the photo
estimate threshold, the exclusions carried as switches, the appeal window and appeal count, the
plan-change notice, effective period and downgrade lockout, the minimum enrolment and cancellation notice,
the suspension grounds, the portfolio rules, the acceptance limits by plan, the out-of-region days, the
roadside allowance, the trip fee offset and commercial use. The `eligibility` blocks' evidence contracts are
rendered as the authority sentences they are (e.g. "That the trip reached one of those two states is read
from the trip's own booking record for that vehicle, and not from the host's description of it"), with the
correct timing (`pre_action`) and boundary (inclusive at the last hour, at the last day).

Retired surface, all three that bear on this task:

| Retired clause (source `overwrite.superseded_clause`) | Document | Written as retired? | Residue |
|---|---|---|---|
| "The report must carry at least the plan's minimum number of photographs before it becomes a claim" | `reporting_a_loss_onto_the_register_be66e722.json` | yes — "This clause is no longer in force and is not applied to any report." | "The remainder of that provision stands: a report is completed within the plan's evidence period, counted in whole calendar days from the day the report was lodged." Exactly the surviving limb of the source sentence. |
| "The accepted amount is capped twice over, first by the sublimit … and the lower of the two governs" | `valuing_a_loss_and_what_the_plan_accepts_64226c25.json` | yes | "The remainder of that provision stands unchanged: sublimits are not added together where one loss spans several kinds of damage, each kind being capped on its own." Exactly the surviving limb. |
| Both deductible clauses (plan in force on the day of the loss; claim-free discount and waiver) | `the_hosts_own_share_of_an_accepted_loss_d19558cb.json` | yes — "Neither clause is applied to any share raised on an enrolment." | the policy's four unnamed clauses are carried as clauses in force, and the surviving measurement sentence ("The months an enrolment has gone without an accepted claim are counted in whole calendar months from the claim-free day standing on the enrolment to the day the matter is handled") is carried — it is what the extended claim-free factor needs. |

No retired clause is stated as a rule in force, none has vanished, and the KB retires nothing the source did
not declare retired. The residues read as one coherent rule: the retired photograph minimum is replaced by
the extended count the hub's own prerequisite sentence refers to; the retired double cap is replaced by the
single cap the extended baseline states; the retired deductible basis and claim-free relief are replaced by
the extended basis factor and the extended claim-free ladder, which differ from the retired clauses in
substance (the extended waiver requires both the waiver period and nothing standing unpaid, and acts on the
share rather than on the deductible), so a reader meets a succession, not a contradiction.

## kb_to_source

Every normative claim in the four hubs, four computation documents, twenty factor documents and the base
policy and facet documents that bear on this task was traced back. The parameter lists, owners, return
descriptions and enumerations in the hubs match the tool contracts. No document states a business
obligation, eligibility, prohibition, calculation, question, confirmation, wait, review, notification,
exception or step the source does not have. Specifically, nothing of the "please confirm the amount with the
customer", "review again before handling", "notify after completion" or "if it fails, follow this procedure"
kind appears anywhere in the corpus.

**The two prerequisite-specific checks:**

- *Cross-problem operational guidance*: none. No document tells the reader to call another problem's tool
  first, or names a resolving action beside a state-form sentence. A full-text scan of all 82 documents for
  each of the eight task-tool names found each tool named only inside its own hub's invocation block.
- *A task's opening world state written in as a policy fact*: none. A scan for this task's own figures —
  41200, 62800, 38500, 2965, 2771, 975, 16, the postal code, the vehicle, the city, the names, the estimate
  reference — returned no hit anywhere in the corpus. Every worked example is labelled hypothetical and uses
  figures that are not this world's.

**Additions found (both carried over into the verdict below as observations, not as changed semantics):**

1. `what_the_plan_accepts_on_an_appraised_loss_25bb78a3.json` — "Loss of use is paid at the plan's daily sum
   for the days the vehicle stands off the road, never for more days than the plan's longest period **and
   never for fewer than none**". The second limb appears in no `rule` or `baseline.rule` sentence of the
   source; it exists only as `MN(MX(off_road_days_counted, 0), plan_lou_max_days)` in `compute`.
2. `provisional_figure_a_claim_opens_at_94ccefe8.json` — "rounded to two decimal places once, at the end
   **and never at an intermediate step**", where the source's `baseline.rule` stops at "once, at the end".

Neither changes a permitted action, parameter, order or result: (1) states the floor the source's own
executable applies and can only prevent a negative day count, (2) is entailed by "once, at the end". Both are
recorded as source-side under-statements of `baseline.rule` rather than as document defects.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS** for task 0.

Every normative atom of this task's four extended policies and of the base policies governing their
subjects is entailed by the product's documents; nothing is unborne, nothing is borne with changed meaning,
and no claim from outside the source appears. Every tier of every one of the twenty declared factors is
carried in full in its own factor document and is findable from the words this customer's records use. All
three prerequisite sentences stand verbatim, in their declared state form, in the hub of the policy they
block and in no other policy's document.

This is revision 1; there are no previous revisions of this file.

**A product-level finding recorded here for completeness, outside this task's policy set:**
`money_released_by_a_withdrawal_d2280f0d.json`, the computation document of
`hostplan_ext_claim_withdrawal`, widens the base of the calculation to include supplements, which the source
excludes. It bears on task 1 and is scored there; see
`audits/policy_kb/host_protection_and_claims_desk/1.md`. Task 0 instantiates none of that policy, so it does
not enter this task's verdict.
